title: Remote project onboarding needs a hand-edited exact-scope producer grant plus a daemon redeploy, and the redirect error omits that step
wanted_capability: One agent-drivable onboarding path for a new checkout on a remote-daemon estate: a producer-level auto-grant policy so the onboard route can admit a new committed scope without a daemon config edit and pod restart, a single collector-side command that scaffolds, derives the scope, enrolls the project and triggers onboarding without a service restart, and an instance-rendered onboarding skill served over MCP (skills extension, resource, and prompt) in place of the static error redirect.
missing_primitive: Producer auto-grant policy; collector add/reload subcommand; daemon-served instance-specific onboarding skill.
fallback_used: Agents hand-append a [[projects]] block to the collector config, run collector init, restart the launchd collector, then separately edit the daemon producer grant table and run the cage converge (pod roll), then commit .bbox/config.toml and restart the collector again. When the grant step is missed the collector returns 403 scope_forbidden silently for days.
resolution_note: Implemented on invidious9000/skills-as-mcp-resources (tip 07c03b95) and deployed to the cage: producer claim_scopes/auto_publish policies with a durable claims store, collector add + enrolled-projects sidecar + live reload, producer command channel routing bbox_project_register on remote paths to the covering collector, and the onboard-project skill served over MCP skills/list, resources, and prompts. Verified live: a throwaway repository registered with one bbox_project_register call, then one identity commit, and was searchable and auto-published on the next collector pass.
